author: DJI
description:
Experience the ultimate Mount Qomolangma expedition captured in a single continuous shot with the DJI Mavic 4 Pro. This groundbreaking video takes you on an uninterrupted aerial journey from the North Col Glacier at 6500m-7028m, soaring through Windy Pass (7028m-7500m), Camp 2 (7790m), Camp 3 (8300m), Yellow Band (8400m), First Stage (8564m), Second Step (8610m), Third Step (8710m), all the way to the Traverse at 8800m.

This one-shot masterpiece immerses you in the raw, breathtaking ascent of the world’s highest peak, showcasing the power and precision of the DJI Mavic 4 Pro.

🎬 Video by ‪Chunlinmark‬ 

#DJIMavic4Pro #QomolangmaOneShot #DroneFootage #MountQomolangma #HighAltitudeDrone #EpicFlight #Nature #adventurefilm
title: Rotate Your Phone, Experience Fly through the Roof of the World | DJI Mavic 4 Pro
